name: BT Quote
changelog:
0.3.0

  • Quick Quote tool now lives in the plugin: [bt_quick_quote] is registered here, so the BT-Quick-Quote-Tool snippet can be deactivated.
  • Prefilled quote links — the tool seeds itself from URL params (qty, g, loc, m, et, r), so a link can arrive with all three boxes already filled in.
  • New Copy Quote Link button under the results builds that link from what is on screen.
  • Submitted quotes now include the link in the email to orders@.
  • Shortcode attributes set page-level defaults; a URL param always wins.
  • Admin page reports which copy is serving the shortcode, and lists the link params.
v0.2.2 — Admin menu grouping now includes BT Portal.
